events.title: Fangtopia to appear in Cozy Quest
events.summary: Hi everyone! Fangtopia will be appearing in Cozy Quest 2025, hosted by Secret Mode. We're thrilled to confirm there will be a big announcement during the event! Cozy Quest runs 17th-20th November and the opening showcase will take place on 17th November at 6pm GMT on YouTube and Steam.This link will take you to the event page when it goes live: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CozyQuest2025 See you then, and as always - stay spooky!
